request_fields.name: mode
request_fields.description: Detection mode: default (auto ligand detection) / peptide (--peptides, inter-chain) / intra (--intra, intra-chain) / dnareceptor (treat nucleic acids as receptor).

request_fields.name: peptide_chains
request_fields.description: mode=peptide: chain IDs treated as peptide ligands (--peptides A B).

request_fields.name: intra_chain
request_fields.description: mode=intra: single chain to analyze for intra-chain contacts (--intra A).

request_fields.name: report_formats
request_fields.description: Report formats to emit: any non-empty subset of {xml, txt}.
request_fields.default_note: use the tool's default when omitted

request_fields.name: pymol_session
request_fields.description: Also write a PyMOL session (.pse) per binding site (-y).

request_fields.name: render_images
request_fields.description: Also render ray-traced images (.png) per binding site (-p).

request_fields.name: name
request_fields.description: Report basename stem (output/<name>.xml / .txt).

request_fields.name: breakcomposite
request_fields.description: Do not combine covalently-bound ligand fragments (--breakcomposite).

request_fields.name: altlocation
request_fields.description: Keep alternate atom locations (--altlocation).

request_fields.name: nofix
request_fields.description: Turn off automatic PDB fixing (--nofix).

request_fields.name: keepmod
request_fields.description: Keep modified residues as ligands (--keepmod).

request_fields.name: nohydro
request_fields.description: Do not add polar hydrogens (structure already protonated) (--nohydro).

request_fields.name: model
request_fields.description: Model number for multi-model structures (--model).

request_fields.name: maxthreads
request_fields.description: Override PLIP_THREADS for this call (--maxthreads).

examples.notes: Chain I is treated as a peptide ligand; also writes .pse per binding site.

job_lifecycle.poll_recommendation: Poll the status endpoint every 5–120 s until status ∈ {'completed', 'failed'}. On failure, JobInfo.error_summary holds a one-line exception summary and error_tail holds the trailing ~4 KB of the subprocess log — usually enough for triage without a separate /log fetch.
job_lifecycle.restart_semantics: Jobs survive process and FC instance restarts via a `job.json` sidecar in each job directory. Jobs that were RUNNING at the moment of restart are downgraded to FAILED with failure_kind='interrupted'.

nas_layout.cross_instance_consistency: When multiple FC instances mount the same NAS at jobs_base_dir, all of them can see each other's jobs via read-through cache on GET. Writes (create/update) only happen on the instance that owns the subprocess.
nas_layout.cross_service_sharing: Other bioagent services mounted on the same NAS can read this service's output files directly by path, avoiding HTTP round-trips. Example: another service does `Path('/data/rfantibody_jobs/<id>/output/file.qv').read_bytes()`.

service_specific.protocol: PLIP is CPU-only and rule-based (no GPU, no model weights). It reads ONE PDB complex (protein + ligand already present) and reports the non-covalent interactions it detects. It does NOT score, predict affinity, or prepare structures.

tool_outputs.profile: output/<name>.xml — structured interaction report (primary machine-readable output; see report/bindingsite/interactions). output/<name>.txt — human-readable RST report. output/*.pse — PyMOL sessions per binding site (pymol_session=True). output/*.png — ray-traced images (render_images=True). output/<name>_protonated.pdb — PLIP's fixed/protonated structure.
tool_outputs.note: Enumerate via GET /api/jobs/{id}/files; single file via /api/jobs/{id}/file/{relpath}; whole dir via /download.

modes.peptide: Treat given chain(s) as peptide ligands / inter-chain contacts (peptide_chains required).
modes.intra: Intra-chain contacts within one chain (intra_chain required; slow on large structures).
modes.dnareceptor: Treat DNA/RNA as part of the receptor rather than as a ligand.

input_uri_schemes.job://<id>/<file>: Re-use a PDB from a prior job.
input_uri_schemes.file:///abs/path: Direct NAS path on the shared mount.
Generic URL, including OSS signed URLs.

service_specific.not_in_scope_v0_0_1: batch multi-structure; fetch-by-PDB-ID over the network (-i); --chains / --regions advanced receptor/ligand grouping; geometric threshold tuning (--hbond_dist_max etc.); stdout reports (-O); gzip (-z). PLIP does not score or predict affinity.
